shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them (stack + log-prefix + Harmony patch-owner attribution, a shipped known-issue library plus a benign "no-concern" library, mod-shipped + opt-in community bug DBs, an optional Circinus corpus-prevalence bridge, About.xml incompat + proactive dependency/load-order scan, and a glossary), a global knowledge-base browser, an in-game bug/fix report composer, a suite-styled mod-settings page in parity with the Modules window, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette, plus impact scoring and updated-mod tracking.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT).

### Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. `GameFont.Tiny` is banned suite-wide with one deliberate exception: the dev palette's category line (see Tool 3). Shipped icons in `Textures/UI/DevTools/` via `MdtTex`. `Palette.SearchField` = suite-styled single-line text/search field. `Palette.ToggleRow`/`ToggleRowHeight` = shared full-width settings row (label + right-side switch + optional measured/wrapped dim description; whole row is the click target) used by both settings surfaces. Also `DrawCard`, `SectionHeader`, `DrawToggle`, `GrayButton`, `StateStrip`, `LabelFit`, `BeginScroll`.
- **Text-scaling rule:** never scale text with `GUI.matrix` inside a `Window` — the matrix is applied outside the window's GUI clip, so labels render in screen space (they appeared floating over the map). Use the three built-in fonts and size every text rect from `Text.LineHeightOf(font)`.

### Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`. Left list (culled) + right inspector. Inspector: impact banner (`ImpactAssessor`) → likely source (ranked culprits) → "What this means" (diagnoses, sorted by Score) → module `DrawSection` hooks (glossary) → report card → stack trace.
- **Auto-open suppression toggle (settings, off by default): `dontAutoOpenAtMainMenu`.** `Patch_CheckOpenLogWindow` suppresses auto-open while `ProgramState.Entry`; still auto-opens in-game; manual open always works.
- **Toolbar B buttons (right→left):** Clear, Copy all, Modules, Update info, **Knowledge base** (`MDT_KbButton`, opens `Window_KnowledgeBase`), then the search field fills the rest.
- **Copy affordances:** toolbar `Copy all` (whole in-memory buffer) + per-message `Copy message` / `Copy stack trace` / `Copy report` in the inspector. Note vanilla has *no* log-upload button (the remembered "share logs" is HugsLib's `LogPublisher`, which reads `Player.log` off disk, redacts paths/Steam ID, and gists it via an embedded token — deliberately not cloned). `Copy all` only serializes the in-memory list, so pre-window and Unity-native output are missing; a file-based "Copy full log" bundle is a considered-but-unbuilt follow-up.

### Impact scoring (`ImpactAssessor`) — location is NOT frequency
Computes the inspector's impact banner from severity + stack signals + repeat count.
- **The rule, learned from a bug:** `TickSignals`/`FrameSignals` only prove *where* an error happened, and nearly everything runs under `TickManager.DoSingleTick` (incidents, quests, one-shot storyteller events). Being in the tick loop *once* costs nothing. **A performance claim therefore requires recurrence (`msg.repeats`), never hot-path frames alone.** The original code flagged a single self-healing vanilla raid fallback as "Critical — affects simulation (TPS)" purely because the storyteller ticks.
- Thresholds: `RepeatingThreshold = 3`, `SpamThreshold = 10`; `hot = (tick||frame) && repeating`. Critical requires `spam || hot`; a one-off error tops out at **High**. Warnings mirror this (Moderate needs `spam || hot`, else Low). `BuildPerfNote` emits TPS/FPS text only when `repeating`, else "one-off".
- **Curated override:** `ErrorDiagnosis.MaxImpact` (fed by `KnownIssueDef.maxImpact`) caps the level. `ImpactLevel` runs `Critical=0 → Info=4`, so the cap is "never more severe than this" and the default (`Critical`) is a no-op. When capped, the TPS/FPS note is dropped too (a "at most Low" assertion contradicts it) and `ImpactResult.Capped` is set.
- **"Known issue" badge means a CURATED entry matched** — `ImpactResult.Known` reads `Diagnoses.Any(d => d.FromLibrary)`. It previously read `Diagnoses.Count > 0`, so any heuristic module (Harmony, dependency, version) lit the badge for errors the library had never seen — "Critical" + "Known issue" together read as *we know this is bad* and sent people chasing phantoms. `FromLibrary` is set **only** by `Module_KnownIssues`, `Module_ModIssues`, `Module_CommunityBugs`.

### Knowledge-base content & factual-provenance convention
The shipped knowledge is spread across four libraries. **Factuality rule: every match string must be a verbatim engine string, verified against decompiled Verse/RimWorld source, and every data entry carries a `source file:line` provenance comment** so any maintainer can re-confirm it. Unbiased rule: shipped defs never name a third-party mod (attribution stays runtime-computed from the stack); `fix` text is always user-actionable ("update / check dependencies / report the trace"), never "mod X is bad". Specific-mod claims live only in the community DB behind `verified`/`reportedBy` flags. Current inventory:
- **`Defs/KnownIssueDefs.xml` — 42 always-on entries.** Sections: load-time mod metadata warnings; exceptions; **startup & initialization** (`MDT_StaticConstructor`, `MDT_UninitializedDefOf`, `MDT_ConfigErrors`); def/XML data problems (incl. `MDT_CustomXmlLoader`); patches/load-order/save-load (incl. `MDT_LoadIdReference`, `MDT_SaveVersionMismatch` [ignorable], `MDT_LongEventException`); **self-healing vanilla fallbacks** (`MDT_RaidArrivalFallback`, `MDT_RaidStrategyFallback` — both `ignorable` + `maxImpact=Low`, from `IncidentWorker_Raid.cs:57`/`:38`, where vanilla logs at Error severity but immediately substitutes `EdgeWalkIn`/`ImmediateAttack` and the raid runs normally); pawn AI/jobs/world state (`MDT_JobException`); common .NET exceptions; content/quests/UI. `MDT_RootOnGUI` covers both `Root.OnGUI()` and `Root.Update()`.
- **`Defs/BenignLogDefs.xml` — 5 benign "no concern" lines** (version banner, command line, save-data override, new-game/loaded-save mod lists). Anchored patterns only; must never swallow a real error.
- **`Data/community-bugs.json.gz` — 17 verified generic patterns** (our contributor-editable DB).
- **Glossary — ~26 plain-language terms** (see below).

**`KnownIssueDef` fields:** `fix`, `url`, `priority`, `ignorable`, `benign`, **`maxImpact`** (impact ceiling; default `Critical` = no opinion — use only on tightly anchored patterns, since a cap on an over-broad entry would hide genuine failures that co-match), `attributeRegex`, and the match lists `exceptionTypes`/`keywords`/`regexes`/`namespaces`/`packageIds`. Keyword matching lowercases **both** sides (`KnownIssueIndex`), so keywords are authored lowercase.

### Benign "no concern" classification
Normal no-fault vanilla log lines classified via `KnownIssueDef.benign` (curated in `Defs/BenignLogDefs.xml`). `KnownIssueIndex.HasBenignMatch(ctx)` runs before the module loop (only when `msg.type != Error`), sets `ctx.Benign`; while set, `ErrorContext.Merge` no-ops all attribution. Inspector shows a green "No concern" badge, forces impact to Info, hides the report card. Distinct from `maxImpact`: benign = "nobody is at fault, this is normal output"; `maxImpact` = "a real fallback happened, it just isn't severe".

### Analysis modules ("What this means") + extensibility
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext`. Per module: `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose`, in `def.order`; diagnoses sorted by `Score`. Modules: `Module_StackTrace`, `Module_LogPrefix`, `Module_MessageMentions`, `Module_HarmonyPatches`, `Module_VersionMismatch`, `Module_KnownIssues`, `Module_ModIssues`, `Module_Community`, `Module_CommunityBugs`, `Module_AboutIncompat`, `Module_DependencyCheck`, `Module_CircinusCorpus`, `Module_Glossary`. All 13 defs live in the single flat `Defs/ErrorModules.xml`.
- **Index prewarm** (`Bootstrap` → `InstalledModIndex.Prewarm()` off-thread). Harmony index built lazily on first analysis.
- **Harmony patch-owner attribution** (`HarmonyIndex` + `Module_HarmonyPatches`): reverse-maps `"Type.FullName:Method" → owner-id[]`. Diagnosis when ≥2 foreign patchers or a Harmony-routed trace. Self excluded. Heuristic — never sets `FromLibrary`.
- **Proactive dependency & load-order scan** (`ModDependencyIndex` + `Module_DependencyCheck`, order 60): mirrors vanilla `GetModWarnings`/`FindConflicts`.
- **Plain-language glossary** (`Glossary` + `Module_Glossary`, `DrawSection`, order 900). ~26 terms, each with a `MDT_Gl*`/`MDT_Gl*Def` Keyed pair.

### Diagnosis Score scale (house rule — read before adding a module)
`ErrorDiagnosis.Score` sorts the "What this means" list descending. The scale is **single digits**:
- `Module_ModIssues` 9 + (n−i); `Module_CommunityBugs` 8 + (n−i); `Module_DependencyCheck` 8–8.5; `Module_AboutIncompat` 7; `Module_Community` 6–7; `Module_HarmonyPatches` 4.5–6.5; `Module_VersionMismatch` 5
- `Module_KnownIssues` **n − i** — a lone curated match scores just **1** (benign entries get +1000 to pin the reassuring card to the top)
Consequence: a curated library entry is numerically the *lowest*-scoring real diagnosis, so any new module that merely adds context must score **< 1**. Two-digit scores silently pin a module to the top of every error.

### Circinus bridge (`Module_CircinusCorpus`, def `MDT_CircinusCorpus`, order 140)
Optional compat module reporting what our sibling mod **Circinus**'s shared corpus knows about the selected error. Gated on `<requiresPackageId>astryl.Circinus</requiresPackageId>`.
- **Reflection, never a reference.** Binds `Circinus.KnownIssues` via `GenTypes.GetTypeInAnyAssembly` + `GetMethod`, using only the string→string primitives Circinus froze (`Describe`, `ImplicatedMod`). A compile-time reference would make the two DLLs a dependency pair and force a load order.
- **Probe is one-shot, fails loudly only when it matters:** type missing = not installed, silent forever. Type present but methods unmatched = contract drift → one `Log.WarningOnce`. Any throw nulls *every* binding.
- **`Score = 0.5f`** — below the curated floor of 1, so prevalence always sorts last. `Ignorable = true`; ignore key `MDT_Module_CircinusCorpus`. Does **not** set `FromLibrary` (prevalence is not recognition).
- **Attribution at `WeightKnownAttr * 0.5f` = 2.0** — under `WeightMessageName` (2.5), far under `WeightStackBase` (5). Only fires when Circinus consents to name a mod (≥25 affected + ≥25 unaffected runs), so dormant on a thin corpus.
- **Open contract risk:** `ImplicatedMod` is public in Circinus but not in its "treat as frozen once published" doc block — an edit adding it was handed over but is applied in the Circinus scope, not here.

### Settings surfaces — parity contract
Two **distinct** layouts sharing the `Palette` visual language; internal rule documented in `Documentation/UI-Parity.md` + checklist comments on `ModernDevToolsSettings`, `SettingsPage`, and `Dialog_Modules`.
- **`ModernDevToolsSettings`** — `moduleEnabled`, `ignoredIssues`, `enableCommunityData`, `dontAutoOpenAtMainMenu`, `experimentalWindowHardening`, `experimentalMapUiHardening` (+ internal `lastSeenVersion`).
- **Mod-settings page (`SettingsPage.Draw`, canonical superset)** — a single scrolling column of suite cards: General, Analysis modules, Ignored warnings, Community data, Experimental hardening. Reserves the 16px scrollbar gutter unconditionally and sizes every rect by measurement so descriptions never clip.
- **Modules & filters window (`Dialog_Modules`, quick-access subset)**. `SourceTag`/`CommunityStatus` are `internal static` and reused by `SettingsPage`.
- **The rule:** anything on the Modules window must also be reachable from the settings page.

### Tool 4: global knowledge base (`Window_KnowledgeBase`)
Source-agnostic reference browser, independent of any selected error. Left rail of 8 categories + right searchable pane; every entry cites provenance. Tabs: Sources, Known issues, Benign log lines, Community bugs, Compatibility, Dependencies, Harmony patches, Glossary.

### Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Off by default; background fetch, cached, offline fallback. Sources: RimSort Community Rules, Use This Instead, and our own **known-issues.json** at `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues` (PUBLIC, live). Offline snapshot ships gzipped at `Data/community-bugs.json.gz`.

### In-game reporting (`ReportBuilder`, `Dialog_Report`)
Server-less composer; destination hierarchy: culprit mod's GitHub → its Workshop page → community Issue Form repo. Signature = FNV-1a → `[#xxxxxxxx]`.

### Tool 2: dev actions window (`Window_ModernDevActions`, 3-tab)
Reuses vanilla `DebugActionNode` graph; adds category "Modern Dev Tools" (`DebugActions_Testing`) with test-log/exception actions (all `Anywhere`-gated). Spawn pickers = searchable icon grid. Esc steps up one level; whole-tab BFS search. `OpenAt(node)` navigates straight to any node.

### Tool 3: dev palette (`Window_ModernDevPalette`)
Reskins `Dialog_DevPalette`. Resolves pinned nodes from `Prefs.DebugActionsPalette` fresh every frame.
- **Label naming (`DebugTree`)**: `PrettyPrefix` stops one level below the tab root; `PrettyLeaf`; `PrettyName` for tooltips/search.
- **Row layout (`DrawRowText`)**: nested actions get a dim Tiny category line with the label in white (Small) beneath. Heights from `Text.LineHeightOf` + `VPad` − `LineOverlap`.
- **Auto-fit width** (`DesiredWidth`), clamped 220–640px.
- **Browser-tab drag-to-reorder** (own drag state, ported from Modern Pawn Tabs — NOT vanilla `ReorderableWidget`): >3px lifts the row, accent insert line, ghost plate. Commits via `ApplyReorder` + `Prefs.Save()`. `HandleDragInput` runs before rows draw; never calls `Event.Use()` on MouseUp (would strand `hotControl`) — `_swallowClick` blocks the row action instead.
- **Submenu rows stay in the suite** (`Patch_DebugActionNodeEnter`).

### Updated-mod tracking + update notes
`GameComponent_ModSnapshot` → indicator → `Dialog_ModChanges`. `Dialog_UpdateNotes` once per Version.

### Experimental hardening (two toggles, off by default)
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening`.

### Testing / environment note
Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`) on focus changes, NOT the mod.

### Localization
`Languages/English/Keyed/ModernDevTools.xml` (`MDT_*`). Impact keys `MDT_Critical`/`High`/`Moderate`/`Low`/`Info`, `MDT_Impact*`, `MDT_Known`/`MDT_Unknown`/`MDT_Benign`. Settings keys `MDT_Settings*`, `MDT_NoMainMenuLog(+Desc)`, `MDT_Section*`, hardening `MDT_*Short`/`*Desc`, community `MDT_Comm*`. Knowledge-base keys `MDT_Kb*`. Glossary keys `MDT_Gl*`/`MDT_Gl*Def` (26 pairs). Circinus keys `MDT_CorpusTitle`, `MDT_ReasonCorpusCorrelation`.

## GitHub Backup
Open source (MIT). Mod repo: **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools** (PUBLIC). Community bug DB (CC0): **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues** (PUBLIC). `origin` on Astryls; `Source/`, `Assemblies/*.dll`, `.modmixer/`, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` tracked; `Source/**/{bin,obj}` ignored.
